description:
clippy::nursery flags missing_const_for_fn on these public chat-server constructors and builder methods:

- backend.rs:75 `OpResult::ok(op_index: usize, id: Option<Id>) -> Self` — struct-literal construction, trivially const-able
- backend.rs:87 `OpResult::err(op_index: usize, error: SetError) -> Self` — same shape
- backend.rs:172 `ChatLimits::new() -> Self` — Default-shaped, all-fields-known
- backend.rs:188 `ChatLimits::with_max_roles_per_space(self, n) -> Self`
- backend.rs:195 `ChatLimits::with_max_space_members(self, n) -> Self`
- backend.rs:202 `ChatLimits::with_max_channels_per_space(self, n) -> Self`
- backend.rs:209 `ChatLimits::with_max_categories_per_space(self, n) -> Self`
- backend.rs:275 `SlowModeError::new(retry_after: Duration) -> Self` — struct-literal

Idiomatic Rust: any constructor or builder that does pure field assignment with no method calls on inputs should be `const fn`. The change is strictly additive — non-breaking for callers — and enables consumers to build these values in `const` contexts (e.g., `const DEFAULT_LIMITS: ChatLimits = ChatLimits::new().with_max_roles_per_space(64);` in a downstream backend's config module).

Engineering basis: zero cost, real benefit. A library kit's public surface should not gratuitously deny callers the const path. The Rust stdlib has been adding `const fn` to constructors of stable types for several editions for exactly this reason; library crates that build on top of stdlib idioms are expected to do the same.

Per the workspace AGENTS.md "Canonical Templates" rule, the same lint should be run on jmap-mail-server's analogous constructors (Mailbox limits, Email construction helpers, etc.) and the fix propagated workspace-wide. Likely a workspace-sweep, not chat-server-local.

Two pure-switch internal helpers (memory.rs:3069 variant_name, permissions.rs:112 required_permissions_for_op, space.rs:189 json_value_kind) are also clippy::nursery missing_const_for_fn candidates but the internal-helper question is lower-leverage and could be folded in or skipped depending on workspace policy.
title: API surface: 5+ public constructor / builder methods could be const fn to enable const consumers
